question.text: A fission reaction is given by <math><mmultiscripts><mrow><mi>U</mi></mrow><mprescripts></mprescripts><mrow><mn>92</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>236</mn></mrow></mmultiscripts><mo>→</mo><mmultiscripts><mrow><mi>X</mi><mi>e</mi></mrow><mprescripts></mprescripts><mrow><mn>54</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>140</mn></mrow></mmultiscripts><mo>+</mo><mmultiscripts><mrow><mi>S</mi><mi>r</mi></mrow><mprescripts></mprescripts><mrow><mn>38</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>94</mn></mrow></mmultiscripts><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi></math> , where <math><mi>x</mi></math> and <math><mi>y</mi></math> are two particles. Considering <math><mmultiscripts><mrow><mi>U</mi></mrow><mprescripts></mprescripts><mrow><mn>92</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>236</mn></mrow></mmultiscripts></math> to be at rest, the kinetic energies of the products are denoted by <math><msub><mrow><mi>K</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>X</mi><mi>e</mi></mrow></msub><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><msub><mrow><mi>K</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>S</mi><mi>r</mi></mrow></msub><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><msub><mrow><mi>K</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></msub><mo>(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi>M</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>V</mi><mo>)</mo></math> and <math><msub><mrow><mi>K</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow></msub><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi>M</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>V</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> , respectively. Let the binding energies per nucleon of <math><mmultiscripts><mrow><mi>U</mi></mrow><mprescripts></mprescripts><mrow><mn>92</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>236</mn></mrow></mmultiscripts><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mmultiscripts><mrow><mi>X</mi><mi>e</mi></mrow><mprescripts></mprescripts><mrow><mn>54</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>140</mn></mrow></mmultiscripts><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi></math> and <math><mmultiscripts><mrow><mi>S</mi><mi>r</mi></mrow><mprescripts></mprescripts><mrow><mn>38</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>94</mn></mrow></mmultiscripts></math> be 7.5 MeV, 8.5 MeV, and 8.5 MeV respectively. Considering different conservation laws, the correct option(s) is (are)

solution.text:
U→Xe+Sr+x+2   y2
Q=4+KXe+KSr ...(i)
-Q=EB=236×7.5-140×8.5-94×8.5
∴Q=219 ...(ii)
∴KXe+KSr=215 MeV
Since, both x & y have same KE
∴ both particles should have same mass & lighter body will have higher KE.
